selected_evidence.requirement: Existing data contents preserved unchanged after repair

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart: reboot acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Deferred 'sleep 2 && systemctl reboot' launched in background; exec call returned 'triggered' immediately, before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart: proof node actually restarted (changed boot identity)
selected_evidence.summary: Connection timed out / reset while node was rebooting, then exec succeeded again with new boot_id feccd3d2-a3f3-4678-9b2c-80e920b737ab and new uptime 08:26:09, proving a genuine restart (not just a service bounce)

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart: post-restart recovery verified (ownership, permissions, data integrity, user/group persisted)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot listing shows unchanged ownership (inventorysvc:inventory-readers), unchanged permissions (750/640), identical md5sums to baseline, and both inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group still present
